steps.title: Start with a rail, a panel and a board
steps.instruction: Join a rail, a panel and a board (A, B, C), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the ÄPPLARÖ bench. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (rail, about 111 cm), B (panel, about 43 cm), C (board, about 115 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 45 cm tall.
